WEEK 1 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Kevin, 139.2-130.8; Adam def. Mitchum, 127.7-120.1; Charles def. Drew, 168.9-116.6 (BLOWOUT); Brent def. Fronge, 126.9-123.5 (NAIL-BITER); Jake def. Wingard, 155.2-123.2; Shaq def. Ryan, 143.9-125.9

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Charles def. Kevin, 169.6-102.1. Crownline wins by 67.5 points. That is not a margin of victory, that is a quarterly earnings report where one company forgot to show up.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-88.2. The man I ranked ninth in my power rankings just dropped 146 on the second-place team. I don't write the Ledger but I am absolutely walking into Matteo's office tomorrow.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Charles as my lock this week. Charles just put up 169.6. I called it. The number is right there. I will not be taking questions but I will be accepting acknowledgment.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I locked Fronge in Week 1, got burned by three points, and watched him go for 146.6 this week against the second-ranked team in the league. The universe is a cruel and precise accountant.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Fronge ninth. Jake second. Final score: 146.6-88.2. I have reviewed my methodology. My methodology would like to speak with a lawyer.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: ADAM DOWN 70.3-98.3 TO BRENT AT FINAL. I RANKED ADAM FIFTH. BRENT EIGHTH. THE OBSIDIAN TE MONOPOLY JUST PICKED ADAM'S POCKET AND LEFT A RECEIPT. BRENT IS 1-1 AND FEELING HIMSELF AND HONESTLY, FINE, HE EARNED IT.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 3-3 on the season, 0-1 on locks, and I am watching everyone else in the pick-em pool act like they invented football. I had Ryan. Ryan had a 0-2 record waiting for him. I regret nothing except the outcome.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Wingard just finished 70.6-79.8 against Shaq. Cooper Rush, DeeJay Dallas, and a 0-2 record. The SDR waiver strategy is now a documented case study and I need a segment — full whiteboard, no interruptions, somebody explain to me how you hoard first-round picks for three years and still have to add Cooper Rush in Week 2.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Five teams just went 2-0. Ryan is 0-2 with 125.9 points through two weeks. The Ledger called that coexistence unsustainable. The Ledger was not being dramatic. The Ledger is never being dramatic.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley covers Mitchum 151.7-145.3 and goes 2-0. Eight trades into the window, Burrow balling in London, and now sole possession of the record he needs. The Apex desk is not panicking. The Apex desk is planning.
